3.name: Risk, UI/UX & Compliance Officer
problemsFound: The cookie consent banner lacks an explicit and easily accessible 'Reject All' (Rifiuta) button on the first layer, which violates the Italian Garante per la protezione dei dati personali guidelines and GDPR standards.

The digital menu and reservation flow feature low contrast text (light grey on white background) and tiny touch targets, creating accessibility barriers for elderly patrons and reducing mobile conversion rates.
solutionsProposed: Redesign the cookie banner to provide equal visual prominence to 'Accept' (Accetta) and 'Reject' (Rifiuta) options on the initial screen, with a link to a granular preference manager.

Streamline the reservation interface by utilizing a 48x48 pixel minimum for touch targets, increasing text contrast to meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 ratio), and reducing input fields to Date, Time, and Party Size.
